CEC Recreations · Annihilation

32 combat enhancement cards, recreated from the recovered art panels (OneDrive archive, upscaled 3×) and the exact printed card text from Warrenborn's archived card pages. Frame, typography and point-badge placement are typeset in the spirit of the 2.0 card design — no complete card scans were ever archived anywhere. Rarity is not shown: it was not captured in the recovery.

29 pts
Null-Signature System
Light
Attaches to Defense
Declare that you are using this gear only at the beginning of an opposing player's turn; it may not be used during your turn or during the turn of an allied teammate. In addition, this gear may be used only when this unit has zero order tokens. (optional) This unit may not be the target of close combat or special attacks, and it gets +8 to its defense value. This unit gains 3 heat and one order token at the end of each order stage in which this gear is used.

22 pts
ECM Suite
Medium
Attaches to Defense
When making ranged combat attacks against this unit, opposing figures ignore their Improved Targeting, if applicable, and they may not reroll attack dice.
SE RULE — Improved Targeting (AoD SEC sheet)
Improved Targeting (optional) When this unit makes a ranged or close combat attack, you may reroll one attack die; if you do, you must accept the reroll result. If you would roll a critical hit with the rerolled die, it is not a critical hit; calculate the attack result normally. If you reroll a die from a critical miss, and the new result is not a critical miss, this unit does not take critical miss damage.

39 pts
Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor
Medium
Attaches to Defense
This gear may be used with this unit's other non-Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor defense special equipment. When an attack scores damage against this unit, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 1-4, reduce the damage scored by 1, to a minimum of 0. On a result of 5, reduce the damage scored by 2, to a minimum of 0. On a result of 6, eliminate this gear; it does not reduce the damage scored, and no player receives victory points for its elimination. This gear does not reduce impact or pushing damage.

Medium
Attaches to Defense
